title: Build supported product candidates
description: Produce faithful supported target archives and the CLI package including browser generation/reading resources from canonical product inputs in isolated safe output. Candidate generation does not install, publish, adopt a target, or manufacture check results.
inputs: Canonical skill/CLI sources, declared resource projections and target transformations.
Requested candidate version, supported population, required package inputs, and temporary or explicit output selection.
Declared bundled browser engine, profiles, renderer binaries, compatibility matrix and license inventory.
outputs: Generated candidate artifacts and exact member inventory.
Explicit rejected inputs, exclusions, unsupported scope, or incomplete generation outcome.
behavior: Derive the supported inventory and candidate support manifest from canonical authored inputs rather than tracked generated output.
Apply declared target transformations, preserving selected behavior and unchanged resource paths/bytes and required dependencies.
Generate equivalent declared contents for identical inputs in isolated safe output; reject missing output intent, overlap, unsafe containment, or use of an active installation as source.
Include the declared executable and required package inputs; keep unsupported targets, wrappers, retired exclusive resources, secrets, and permission-broadening instructions outside accepted output.
Report generation facts without declaring installation, publication, or unexecuted validation success.
Include complete browser generation and reading resources for declared configurations; keep reference documentation snapshots separate from reusable tool candidate identity.

failure_behavior.condition: A required resource is missing, stale, escaped, or unsupported.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject the affected package or report its declared exclusion reason without asserting a complete supported candidate.

failure_behavior.condition: Output selection overlaps canonical or active roots or cannot be established safely.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop before writes and identify the unsafe selection.
Identify incomplete candidate scope and prevent complete-candidate reliance.
